notes_for_editor: Only tnlandforms.us names this tower; the code gfc-107 has no key on the page. Mapcarta (OpenStreetMap and GeoNames based) is used only for the place description. Do not confuse with NHLR's Sylvania Lookout Tower (US 957, GA 15) at 32.76496, -81.64955, about 12 km away at different coordinates. Not on NHLR's Georgia list or FFLOS's Georgia list, checked in the local crawl. No build date, status or access found. The GFC sentence is statewide context only.
